module mg_02171(input clk_i,input reset_n,output reg clk_o);
reg [20:0] count; 
  always @ (posedge clk_i, negedge reset_n) 
  begin 
  count <= count + 1; 
  if(!reset_n) 
  begin 
  clk_o <= 0; 
  count <= 0; 
  end 
  else 
  if(count >= 519999) 
  begin 
  clk_o <= ~clk_o; 
  count <= 0; 
  end 
  end
